§8Purpose and mechanism§r
After preparing the three regular ammo packs, check this task and choose one mimic pack: §17.62§r mm, §120§r mm, or §135§r mm. Mimic packs remain when empty. After §15§r seconds without firing, they regenerate §110,§r §13,§r or §11§r rounds every §12§r seconds, respectively. A LuV assembler can also upgrade a full regular pack using LuV sensors and circuits, a Tinkers' Construct moss ball, Abyssal Obsession, and other materials.

§3Preparation and operation§r
Choose a reward caliber for the weapon you currently use; the other calibers retain their crafting routes. Recovery requires the pause and refill interval, so a mimic pack is not unlimited resupply during uninterrupted fire. Crafting the upgrade needs a full ordinary pack, while the preceding inventory check allows partly used packs. Recheck remaining ammunition before manufacturing.
